Cincinnati Swaps McCrystal to Tokyo for Winker
Officials for <Cincinnati:team#7> confirmed that they have traded 23-year old minor league C <Ryan McCrystal:player#53016>, 19-year old minor league RHP <Ysaias Escalona:player#55017>, and 23-year old minor league RHP <Andrew Shaffner:player#52601> to the <Tokyo Sakuraz:team#402>. In return, the Reds will receive 32-year old minor league LF <Jesse Winker:player#32164>.


Lifetime <Winker:player#32164> is batting .261 with 636 hits, 96 home runs, 352 runs scored and 334 RBIs.
